BiblicalUsage: Hadadezer is a Syrian king. In 2 Samuel 8:3, the text says "David smote also Hadadezer." The life behind the name is told on the Hadadezer, King of Zobah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hadadezer matters because God knows His people by name, and Hadadezer is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
